description: This file is a shell script containing a test suite for verifying the functionality of 'git archive' command, including various archive formats like zip, with different options, and remote repository access over HTTP. It includes setup, validation, and cleanup procedures for multiple test cases related to ZIP archives in Git repositories.

methods.name: check_zip
methods.description: Validates extraction and content correctness of a zip archive created during the tests.

methods.name: check_added
methods.description: Verifies that a specific file has been correctly added to the archive and matches the filesystem.
